heading: Tuesday, February 17, 2026
topLine: 2 model releases: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6 and xAI Grok 4.20.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Sonnet 4.6
items.summary: Claude Sonnet 4.6 upgrades coding, computer use and long-context reasoning and adds a 1M-token context window in beta. Anthropic reports 80.2% on SWE-bench Verified; it became the default model for Free and Pro users at unchanged $3/$15 pricing.

items.headline: xAI launches Grok 4.20 in beta
items.summary: Grok 4.20 launched as a beta for SuperGrok and X Premium+ subscribers, featuring a multi-agent mode in which several agents work in parallel; API access, including a multi-agent variant, followed in March. xAI's documentation lists a 1M-token context and claims a low hallucination rate.
